# Sandy Show Miami

> Official website of MSc. Sandy Fernández Fernández, known professionally as Sandy Show. This site documents his media work, the podcast/interview program Lo de Nosotros No Tiene Nombre, books, music, and professional projects.

## Primary entities
- Sandy Fernández Fernández / Sandy Show: https://sandyshowmiami.com/biografia
- Lo de Nosotros No Tiene Nombre: https://sandyshowmiami.com/programa
- Books by MSc. Sandy Fernández Fernández: https://sandyshowmiami.com/libro
